author: bobyv87
text:
Hi Harry! Can you explain this paragraph with a imaginary chart? Lets look in right order to show you what i understand. a) Hotochin, from the flag i like to trade the FTB to the FL Lets assume that we have a bull flag. After break price make a flag limit. You wait for confirmation on LTF when price return to this FL. The problem is: in LTF our FL its also an entire flag with another FL, in LTF and price goes like that until m1. Can we look at this LTF flag and trade its limits?

b)... and the break of the flag after price returns to it (after it has filled the pole base). This is what i cant understand, Sorry, if i cant explain very clear what i mean, i will make tomorrow youtube video to show you my questions. Thanks, Boby

Harry wrote: Hotochin, from the flag i like to trade the FTB to the FL, and the break of the flag after price returns to it (after it has filled the pole base).

to trade the engulf of the FL would require a few things - that the further FL point is a reaction to something significant. - and also that it gives me a clear place like an FTR or such to base a trade on.

pedini and sunny do that a lot in their journals with good success btw, so they are more experienced in this matter. not all structures are good for such a trade but they find good ones and they work for them

btw, if you have specific example post it and we can discuss it

author: bobyv87
text:
Hi Pedini! Just a few questions: i made some remarks on FL chart from marketpedia. Let me see if i understand correctly:

1) a PAZ its a space between two FL/FTR(compression is a PAZ, FLAG its a Stacked S/D i dont understand how i can consider a paz ) Now, inside a FLAG (PAZ) we can have another FLAGS with their FLs. Fl itself is a FLAG with its FL. How you look correctly for a range and its FL? For compression its clear but for FLAG not. 2) if price break into a PAZ it want to go to the other side of the PAZ.

Fl which define other small flag inside our flag can also act as FTA im alright? How you can see that? There is a video. I think i explained much better there. I hope:D

Pedini wrote: Hiya Wes. The circle you have marked is a FL. It tells us that price is happy to range below that level until it breaks. When it breaks, it sends the signal that price will continue higher.
